measured.frozen_rule: each unsteady row judged against its own point's native log

cdw_equals_cd_on_steady_exports.band: EACH against its own: an export, half a unit of the last digit IT prints on each of the five numbers read off it; a polar row, half a unit on each of its three five-decimal columns PLUS the matched export's allowance; an unsteady polar's CDW against the CD the solver plots for the same group, 2e-5. The verdict is the worst gap over its own band

rotor_table_equals_window_mean.band: 1e-3 of the window mean: CT is printed at five decimals

sector_times_copies_against_full_wheel.band: the ratio within 5 per cent of one: the products state the WHOLE rotor either way

etaw_equals_eta_at_alpha_zero.band: 2e-5: two columns printed at five decimals

etaw_departs_with_alpha.band: ETAW differs from ETA and equals the SIGNED J CTW / CP from the history within 1e-3
